scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,portal "npm run dev --workspace @cvs-garage/backend" "npm run dev --workspace @cvs-garage/portal"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cvs-garage/backend && npm run build --workspace @cvs-garage/portal
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @cvs-garage/backend && npm run test --workspace @cvs-garage/portal
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs && npm run lint --workspace @cvs-garage/backend && eslint "apps/portal/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "services/*/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "packages/*/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @cvs-garage/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @cvs-garage/portal
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke
